Anion Gap

Calculate the anion gap from serum sodium, chloride, and bicarbonate values.

Result

Enter values to calculate

Formula

Anion Gap = Na⁺ − (Cl⁻ + HCO₃⁻)

Clinical interpretation

  • Normal: 8–12 mEq/L
  • Elevated: suggests unmeasured anions or metabolic acidosis
  • Low/negative: uncommon and may reflect hypoalbuminemia or lab artifact

Use alongside albumin, lactate, and clinical context for interpretation.
